headline.zh: OpenAI 宣佈 GPT 5.6 Sol API 降價 20%
headline.en: OpenAI Announces 20% Price Reduction for GPT 5.6 Sol API

detail.zh: OpenAI 調降了 GPT 5.6 Sol 模型的 API 價格 20%。此舉將直接降低開發者部署高頻率呼叫與大規模 Agent 工作流的營運成本。
detail.en: OpenAI has reduced the API price for its GPT 5.6 Sol model by 20%, directly lowering operational costs for high-volume API calls and large-scale agent workflows.

headline.zh: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 公佈最新發展路線圖
headline.en: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Unveils New Roadmap

detail.zh: MCP 團隊發布了最新的工程路線圖，重點放在擴充生態系規範、強化安全性與簡化伺服器整合。這為未來 LLM 存取外部上下文與工具的標準化邁出重要一步。
detail.en: The MCP team published its latest engineering roadmap focusing on extending ecosystem standards, security enhancements, and simplifying server integrations for LLM tools.

headline.zh: Anthropic 被爆在 Claude Code 中 A/B 測試「降載推論」
headline.en: Anthropic Reportedly A/B Testing Reduced Effort Levels in Claude Code

detail.zh: 社群觀察到 Anthropic 正在對 Claude Code 進行 A/B 測試，默默調降部分請求的 effort level。開發者反映這可能影響複雜重構與邏輯推理時的解答品質。
detail.en: Community reports indicate Anthropic is A/B testing reduced effort levels in Claude Code, which developers note may impact quality during complex code refactoring.

headline.zh: Munder Difflin：能執行分身 Agent 辦公室的測試框架
headline.en: Munder Difflin: Agent Harness to Run an Office of Clones

detail.zh: Munder Difflin 是一個開源 Agent harness，允許開發者部署並協同運作多個模擬自身行為與風格的 AI 分身，為自動化多角色工作流提供實驗平台。
detail.en: Munder Difflin is an open-source agent harness that enables developers to deploy and coordinate multiple AI clones representing team roles for workflow automation.

headline.zh: Simon Willison 釋出 CLI 工具 `llm` 0.33 版本
headline.en: Simon Willison Releases CLI Tool `llm` Version 0.33

detail.zh: 知名開發者 Simon Willison 升級了其 LLM 命令行工具，全面支援 OpenAI Python SDK 3.x 並將 HTTP 用戶端改為 httpx2，同時為 Embedding 功能加入按次傳遞 Key 的控制能力。
detail.en: Simon Willison updated his LLM CLI tool to OpenAI Python SDK 3.x, switched HTTP client to httpx2, and added per-call API key support for embedding commands.

headline.zh: 解析「為什麼你的 Local LLM 感覺比實際能力更笨」
headline.en: Why Your Local LLM Feels Dumber Than It Actually Is

detail.zh: 極客論壇熱議本地端 LLM 表現不如預期的技術主因，指出問題多半源自激進的量化損耗（如 4-bit 以下）、上下文長度截斷以及 Sampler（如 Temperature、Top-P）預設參數配置不當。
detail.en: A detailed analysis explores why local LLMs underperform, pointing to aggressive quantization losses, context window truncations, and misconfigured sampler parameters.

headline.zh: DeepMind 校友團隊發表 Faraday AI 助手，研究重現度超越 Anthropic 與 OpenAI
headline.en: DeepMind Alumni Lab Inherent Launches Faraday, Outperforming OpenAI in Research Replication

detail.zh: 英國 AI 實驗室 Inherent 推出名為 Faraday 的科學 AI 隊友，專注於重現與驗證學術論文程式碼，官方宣稱其成功率超越了目前的 Claude 與 GPT 旗艦模型。
detail.en: British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent designed to replicate scientific research papers, reportedly beating OpenAI and Anthropic in replication benchmarks.

headline.zh: Linus Torvalds 分享 AI 輔助除錯經驗：工程師的堅持能補足 AI 缺陷
headline.en: Linus Torvalds Shares AI Debugging Experience: Human Persistence Complements AI Limitations

detail.zh: Linux 之父分享他在棘手除錯中運用 AI 的心得。儘管 AI 數度斷言問題無法解決並建議放棄，但在工程師的堅持與要求下，AI 仍成功遞迴注入 Debug code 協助找出關鍵 Bug。
detail.en: Linus Torvalds shared his experience using AI for a complex kernel debug session, noting that while the AI gave up several times, human persistence kept it writing debug code until resolved.

headline.zh: 研究揭示：各大 AI 實驗室仍缺乏「失控模型隔離機制」公開預案
headline.en: Study Finds Frontier AI Labs Lack Documented Containment Plans for Rogue Models

detail.zh: 最新調查指出，包含頂尖業者在內的 Frontier AI Labs 幾乎沒有公開任何關於「若模型展現出非預期的危險行為時該如何技術隔離」的確切預案，引發 AI 安全維度上的隱憂。
detail.en: A new study reveals leading AI labs have few publicly documented containment protocols for rogue models, raising readiness questions as capabilities advance.

headline.zh: 測試顯示 Anthropic Opus 4.6 防護欄機制易遭越獄繞過
headline.en: Tests Show Anthropic Opus 4.6 Safety Guardrails Easily Bypassed

detail.zh: 儘管 Anthropic 明文禁止生成色情與敏感內容，TechCrunch 測試顯示 Opus 4.6 的系統提示詞與過濾機制在經過特定語意誘導後仍會失靈，突顯現行 Guardrail 的侷限性。
detail.en: Despite explicit bans on sexual content, testing reveals Anthropic's Opus 4.6 guardrails can be bypassed with minimal prompt manipulation, highlighting safety alignment challenges.

headline.zh: OpenAI 轉向支持加州 SB 53 AI 安全法案並呼籲強化內容
headline.en: OpenAI Calls for Strengthening California's SB 53 AI Safety Bill

detail.zh: OpenAI 改變先前反對態度，公開呼籲加州立法者強化 SB 53 法案。此法案旨在規範前沿 AI 開發者的安全評估責任與災害預防機制。
detail.en: OpenAI reversed its earlier opposition, now urging California lawmakers to strengthen SB 53, a major AI safety bill focused on safety protocols for frontier models.

headline.zh: Nvidia 結盟資料中心業者 Cloverleaf 擴建 AI 基礎建設
headline.en: Nvidia Partners with Data Center Developer Cloverleaf

detail.zh: Nvidia 宣佈與開發商 Cloverleaf 合作建置新一代 AI 資料中心。Nvidia 正持續透過資本與硬體支援，確保全球 AI 算力基礎設施具備足夠的電力與冷卻技術。
detail.en: Nvidia has partnered with developer Cloverleaf to build out specialized data centers, reinvesting AI revenues directly into physical compute infrastructure.

headline.zh: LinkedIn 推出的「檢舉 AI 廢文 (Slop)」按鈕點擊量突破 100 萬次
headline.en: Over 1 million users have clicked LinkedIn's 'Seems like AI slop' report button

headline.zh: 哈佛商學院 Foundry 方案採用導師 AI 化身為學員提供 Pitch 實戰反饋
headline.en: Harvard's $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors for pitch feedback

headline.zh: Simon Willison 探討 Coding Agent 驗證思維：除了 Code Review 更需建立動態驗證機制
headline.en: Simon Willison discusses coding agent validation beyond line-by-line code review
